notes.title: Gameplay Brainstorming #1
notes.content:
I'm about to start work on the open world part of the game.

Here, I hope that everyone can actively contribute good ideas and ideas to the content of the game.

I will try my best to realize as many ideas as possible.

Once the relevant content is completed, I will update it in the first time in the way of private testing to provide creative players,

Let everyone be the first to experience the effects of their own ideas in the game. We look forward to your active participation in creating a more wonderful game world together!
